title: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.28626v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memor

translated_title: UniWALM：用于具身机器人控制的统一世界-动作-语言模型
translated_abstract: 受人类能够整合语言、感知与行动经验的启发，我们提出了UniWALM，一个统一的世界-动作-语言模型，它在单一共享表示中学习视频、动作和语言，其中每种模态既是条件信号也是监督目标。我们提出这样一个问题：联合生成语言能否丰富这一共享表示，从而提升操作能力并支持依赖记忆的行为？与以往将推理模型或视觉-语言模型附加到视频-动作主干上并以独立阶段运行的方法不同，UniWALM将三种模态统一在单一的混合变换器主干中，其各模态的扩散头同步协同去噪，在同一遍中与动作一起解码子任务和文本记忆，无需独立的规划阶段；生成的语言会在下一步被重新消费，从而形成“语言即记忆”的闭环，无需外部规划器或记忆模块。
tldr: UniWALM将视频、动作与语言统一在单一共享表示和混合变换器主干中，通过同步协同去噪的扩散头实现动作与文本记忆的同遍生成，形成无需外部规划器的“语言即记忆”闭环，从而提升具身机器人的操作能力和依赖记忆的行为表现。
en_tdlr: UniWALM unifies video, action, and language in a single shared representation within one mixture-of-transformers backbone, whose synchronously co-denoising diffusion heads decode subtasks, textual memory, and action in the same pass, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner to improve manipulation and memory-dependent robot behavior.
